meta.name: to-tickets
meta.description: Break a plan, spec, or the current conversation into a set of tracer-bullet tickets, each declaring its blocking edges, published to the configured tracker (edges as text in one file per ticket locally, or native blocking links on a real tracker).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 拆解方案或讨论为带依赖的任务单
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常把方案或讨论纪要变成任务清单
copy.tagline_en: Turn plans and specs into dependency-aware tickets automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn plans or specs into actionable task lists.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把计划、规格或当前对话拆成一列垂直切片任务（tickets），标出每个任务依赖哪些前置任务，并发布到已配置的追踪器（本地文件或 GitHub/Linear 等）。
howto.when: 当用户要求把计划、规格或当前对话拆成 tickets，或给出文档路径、issue 编号/链接要求拆解时触发。

say.text: 把这份产品需求拆成 tickets
say.note: Claude 会先理解需求，再给出拆分方案征求确认。

say.text: 将当前对话里的计划拆成垂直切片任务
say.note: 按对话内容生成任务列表，并询问粒度是否合适。

say.text: 把 GitHub issue #123 拆成 tickets 并发布
say.note: 会抓取 issue 全文，拆分后发布到已配置的追踪器。

howto.what_en: Claude turns a plan, spec, or conversation into a set of vertical-slice tickets, each listing its blocking tickets, and publishes them to the configured tracker (local files or real tracker via native blocking links).
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to break a plan, spec, or the current conversation into tickets, or hands a document path / issue number / URL to decompose.

say_en.text: Break this product requirement into tickets.
say_en.note: Claude understands it, then proposes a breakdown.

say_en.text: Turn the plan in our conversation into vertical-slice tickets.
say_en.note: Asks whether granularity and blocking edges are right.

say_en.text: Split GitHub issue #123 into tickets and publish them.
say_en.note: Fetches the issue, splits it, and publishes to the tracker.
